correctness.rationale: Kőnig two-vertex-cover enumeration gives exactly 4,087 augmented faces; an explicit 2,011-pair matching is acyclic on every one of 15,390 directed Hasse covers; 5 degree-2 and 60 degree-3 Morse critical cells remain. Exact integer gradient-path boundary has a 5x5 determinant +1 minor (critical degree-3 columns 1,5,12,18,48), proving the integral 55-three-sphere wedge. All 216 original graph automorphisms are independently enumerated and every signed Lefschetz trace computed; the eleven cycle-type blocks have integral trace sum 432, hence invariant dimension two. Standalone verifier paths and deterministic output were replayed. No infinite extrapolation or independent verification is asserted.

value.rationale: The Pappus 9_3 incidence graph is a canonical maximally symmetric 18-vertex cubic bipartite graph. The exact integer homotopy model at the natural first nontrivial three-matching threshold fills a motivated gap in recent non-matching persistence theory, which gives top-homology persistence but not exact classifications. The full 216-element rational character adds genuinely discriminating data: different involution traces and two invariant directions. The object/parameter is intrinsic, not an arbitrary slice or a table recomputation.
